name: Salamis
line: Salamis was a seaport city on the east coast of Cyprus, where Paul and Barnabas first preached the word of God after sailing from the mainland.

moments.title: Arriving to preach
moments.text: Barnabas and Saul, sent by the Holy Spirit, sailed to Cyprus. When they arrived at Salamis, they proclaimed the word of God in the Jewish synagogues, and John was with them as their helper.
